title: fix: SELECT AID response not validated — any SW 9000 accepted without checking returned AID
description:
wp11_piv_select() sends SELECT with the PIV AID and accepts any SW 9000 response as success, without inspecting the response payload. ISO 7816-4 §7.1.1 and NIST SP 800-73-4 §2.3.1 specify that SELECT returns an FCI (File Control Information) template containing the selected AID.

Failure mode: a token that returns SW 9000 for any SELECT (or for the wrong applet) will be treated as a successful PIV AID selection. Subsequent GENERAL AUTHENTICATE commands sent to the wrong applet may return 6D00 or 6E00 (instruction/class not supported), or — worse — be processed by a different applet with unpredictable results.

Fix: After checking SW 9000, parse the SELECT response to verify:
1. Response is a valid FCI template (tag 0x6F or 0x61 per ISO 7816-4)
2. The returned AID (tag 0x84) matches the PIV AID bytes (defined at wp11_proto_piv.c:18)
3. If response is empty (some tokens return SW 9000 with no body), accept it — not all tokens return FCI
4. If response contains a mismatched AID, return WP11_PIV_ERR_SW (not OK)

Add comment: 'SP 800-73-4 §2.3.1: validate FCI response AID if present; empty response is also valid per ISO 7816.'

This prevents silent applet confusion on multi-applet tokens.
